title: Microsoft presents: Introducing M365 Copilot Chat in Business Central

chapters.title: Copilot experiences in Business Central so far
Evolution from chat to agents and immersive experiences
Demo: M365 Copilot chat in Business Central
Replacing old Copilot chat with M365 Copilot and architecture
New M365 Copilot context and agentic loop capabilities
Tools approach and agentic loop execution
Read-only capabilities, timeline, and release planning
Preview access, version compatibility, and extensibility
External access, troubleshooting, and closing remarks

features.name: M365 Copilot chat in Business Central
features.description: Integration of M365 Copilot chat as the home for all copilot experiences in Business Central, replacing the previous isolated BC chat with unified platform access to agents, co-work, and autopilots. Allows users to query business central data, access chat history across Microsoft 365 applications, and integrate with other Microsoft products.
caveats: Business Central data querying only available when using Copilot inside BC
BC integration currently limited to within Business Central, not available in Outlook or Teams yet
Other Microsoft product integrations being brought on gradually
Read-only in first version
Requires Copilot license for full capability
Limited to BC 29 and later versions
Not available for on-premises
Full details on free access are TBD
Technical details of credit consumption still being determined
Replaces existing chat functionality

features.name: Business Central data access from chat
features.description: Ability to query and retrieve Business Central data through natural language questions in M365 Copilot chat, with citations and sourcing information provided. Read-only access to analyze data across tables and extract meaningful information.
caveats: Only available when using chat within Business Central
Does not query BC when accessed from Outlook or Teams
Cannot take actions in Business Central yet
Performance depends on data volume and tenant settings
Read-only queries only

features.name: Chat history persistence across Microsoft 365
features.description: Chat conversations conducted in M365 Copilot Chat within Business Central can be accessed and continued from Outlook, Teams, and other Microsoft 365 applications. Links and information from chat history remain accessible outside BC.
caveats: BC data will not be queried when accessing chat from other applications
BC integration is limited to when you use Copilot inside Business Central

features.name: Export copilot analysis to Word
features.description: Ability to export charts, data analysis, and research conducted in M365 Copilot chat to Word documents with all links and gathered information preserved.

features.name: Enhanced record summarization
features.description: Improved ability to summarize and provide detailed information about Business Central records and pages through M365 Copilot, with metadata handling and richer responses. Summarization feature available on every page providing automatic document summarization.
caveats: Previously only returned small adaptive cards
Now provides more detailed information about records

features.name: Copilot Studio agents integration
features.description: Integration of Copilot Studio agents as part of the unified M365 Copilot chat experience in Business Central. Copilot Studio agents are fully supported and users can build agents to perform specific tasks like creating invoices and talk to those agents through M365 Copilot Chat.
caveats: Integration strategy being developed gradually

features.name: LLM-powered bank reconciliation
features.description: Use of large language models for intelligent bank statement reconciliation through semantic meaning comparison rather than exact text matching.

features.name: LLM-powered auto-fill
features.description: Use of LLM technology to provide intelligent field suggestions based on semantic meaning rather than text matching.

features.name: Sales order agent
features.description: Agent that reads emails from Outlook and automatically creates sales orders, eliminating manual email chasing.

features.name: Page and record context in Copilot chat
features.description: The new Copilot chat now understands the page you are viewing and the specific record you are looking at, allowing it to respond contextually to questions about the data currently on screen.
caveats: Limited to when used inside Business Central

features.name: Message attachments in M365 Copilot
features.description: Users can now attach documents like invoices to their chat messages and ask Copilot questions about the information within those documents.

features.name: Agentic loop for multi-step queries
features.description: The new M365 Copilot uses an agentic loop that can execute multiple tool calls sequentially to complete complex tasks, allowing it to ask itself whether more information is needed.

features.name: Business Central tools suite for Copilot
features.description: A new suite of Business Central tools is provided for M365 Copilot including ability to retrieve data, get help, and read extensions.

features.name: Rich content delivery in Copilot responses
features.description: M365 Copilot can now deliver rich content back to users including documents, Excel attachments, and videos instead of just text links. Copilot Chat now provides rich citations with links and video content.

features.name: M365 Copilot replaces Copilot chat in BC
features.description: The existing Copilot chat in Business Central is being completely replaced with M365 Copilot, which includes all previous capabilities plus new features and cross-product integration.
caveats: The previous Copilot chat is going away completely

features.name: Cross-product capability within M365 Copilot
features.description: Users can carry conversations from Business Central to Outlook, Teams, and other Microsoft products, and M365 Copilot can alternate between BC tools and M365 tools to answer questions.
caveats: BC integration is limited to when you use Copilot inside Business Central

features.name: Copilot license requirement for M365 Copilot in BC
features.description: To use M365 Copilot features in Business Central, including access to Copilot in other Microsoft products, users need a Copilot license.
caveats: Using Copilot in Business Central does not mean you get access to the full suite of Copilot for free

features.name: Limited BC-only access investigation
features.description: Microsoft is investigating whether to provide limited access to M365 Copilot for users with only BC licenses, operating only on BC data without full Copilot license.
caveats: Details still being worked out
Official announcement pending

features.name: Permission policy enforcement
features.description: All M365 Copilot tools integrated with BC are executed as the user with their permission sets and access controls still applying. Data access and protection mechanisms remain unchanged.

features.name: Copilot access control via admin portal
features.description: Administrators can control who has access to M365 Copilot through the Copilot and agent capabilities page with opt-in/opt-out options. Regional privacy controls available for integrations like Bing.

features.name: M365 admin portal configuration for Copilot
features.description: Administrators can configure M365 Copilot features through admin portal including workflow enablement, chat retention period, data loss protection, and SharePoint exposure limits. Chat history stored encrypted per regional requirements.

features.name: Audit logs with Purview integration
features.description: Organizations can securely store audit logs for Copilot interactions through Purview integration, included with M365 Copilot chat.

features.name: Read-only Copilot Chat
features.description: For the first version, M365 Copilot Chat in BC is read-only. Users can get guidance and suggestions on how to perform tasks but cannot directly create sales orders, items, or perform write actions in BC.
caveats: Future capabilities for write actions still TBD

features.name: M365 integrations from day one
features.description: Various M365 integrations will be available from day one of M365 Copilot Chat in BC, including the ability to send emails through Outlook and other integrations.
caveats: Not necessarily performing tasks in client live

features.name: Copilot Studio agent integration for task automation
features.description: Users can build Copilot Studio agents to perform specific tasks like creating invoices and talk to those agents through M365 Copilot Chat in BC.

features.name: Partner extension guidance for Copilot
features.description: Partners should ensure extensions contain meaningful information by adding tooltips to fields, naming things well, and making page names more descriptive. These are used to train Copilot on how to use extensions.

features.name: Bing Search integration for documentation
features.description: M365 Copilot uses Bing Search to find answers from third-party documentation and the wider web. Partner content must be indexed by Bing to be discoverable.

features.name: MVP private preview access
features.description: M365 Copilot Chat is currently in limited private preview for MVPs who can access it through Viva Engage.
features.status_evidence_quote: we are actually already in a a limited private preview for MVPs.
caveats: MVP only at this stage

features.name: BC 29 public release planned
features.description: M365 Copilot Chat planned for public release in BC 29, expected sometime between October and April. Exact dates to be confirmed via LinkedIn and Viva Engage.
features.status_evidence_quote: we're planning a public release for BC 29. I was allowed to disclose this at least. We're not exactly sure when.
caveats: Exact dates not confirmed
October to April timeframe

features.name: Partner preview access before BC 29
features.description: Partners can get access to private preview before official BC 29 rollout using partner sandbox license through early access sandboxes.
features.status_evidence_quote: we are hoping to give access to to that preview in the coming months before the official rollout, of course.
caveats: Requires partner sandbox license
Via early access sandboxes

features.name: BC 29 and later only
features.description: M365 Copilot Chat is available from BC 29 onwards only. Not available for BC 28 and earlier versions, including on-premises BC 14.
caveats: No on-premises support

features.name: No custom tool addition currently
features.description: At the moment, users cannot add their own tools to M365 Copilot Chat. The extensibility model is via Copilot Studio for building agents.
caveats: Future custom tools development unclear

features.name: Copilot Studio as extensibility model
features.description: The current extensibility model for M365 Copilot Chat is via Copilot Studio, where users can build agents to integrate with BC and M365 Copilot.

features.name: Credit consumption model under review
features.description: Technical details of how M365 Copilot Chat uses Copilot license credits in BC are still being determined. Microsoft is looking into providing similar free access as current chat capabilities without requiring full Copilot license.
caveats: Details TBD
Similar to Teams free read-only access model being explored

features.name: External Copilot Chat Access
features.description: Users and managers want to access Business Central data through Copilot chat outside of Business Central interface to query information like item availability without opening Business Central.
caveats: Requires additional work beyond current implementation
Timeline unclear

features.name: Free Read-Only Access Model
features.description: Aims to provide free read-only access to Business Central via Copilot similar to how Teams integration works, where users without Business Central license but with other Microsoft licenses can get limited access.
caveats: Still being evaluated and designed
Full details TBD

features.name: Copilot Troubleshooting and Data Analysis
features.description: Copilot can read-only access tables to help trace issues like incorrect invoice calculations by querying and analyzing data across multiple sources. Currently limited to read-only operations and cannot take actions in Business Central.
caveats: Cannot take actions in Business Central yet
Performance depends on data volume and tenant settings
Read-only queries only
